title: PresenceReading
description: PIR motion state per zone, normalised by the bridge from a sensor_report and published on sensor.presence. Contains one entry for each zone that has a PIR sensor, as declared in the device hello.

ts.description: Sample time, ISO 8601 UTC, as stamped by the Pi on receipt.

zones.description: Presence per zone with a PIR sensor, at most one entry per zone, canonical order.

present.description: True while the PIR reports motion, held for the sensor hold time of about 3 seconds.
